title: Japan Leads Geolocated Tokenized Treasury Holders but Holds 0.4% of Value
why_it_matters: The split between holder count and capital concentration shows that broader retail access does not necessarily distribute tokenized Treasury liquidity evenly across markets.
caption:
RWA WIRE // MARKETS

Japan Leads Geolocated Tokenized Treasury Holders but Holds 0.4% of Value

Chainalysis data show Japan accounts for 16.4% of geolocated tokenized Treasury holders but only 0.4% of their value, while three other markets hold 66.9% by value.
